lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hermann Shao is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Hermann is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Hermann Shao is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Hermann kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Hermann's gone." Gael looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hermann." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Aisling blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 1). You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hermann Shao, 40 days. The mantle passes to Aisling Moeller.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Aisling Moeller, 59 — a dry cleaner. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally, Berserker Rage, Rain Dancer.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Hermann — and Hermann is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Grayson, Gael, Reiko and 5 more speak for Aisling — "Hermann trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Aisling before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
